notes.title: Update #6: Bug Fixes 4/1/25
notes.content:
[b]Sixth update of Stellar Version 1.0 has just hit Steam![/b]
HI GUYS! First of all, this is NOT an April Fools joke, trust! I was told that Steam achievements weren't being granted to players, so I tested and fixed that for you all today! Thank you everyone, and as always, let me know if there are any other issues that need addressing!

notes.title: Update #5: Bug Fixes 3/14/25
notes.content:
[i][b]Fifth update of Stellar Version 1.0 has just hit Steam![/b][/i]
Hello everyone! I was playing Stellar Version 1.0 casually + in order to confirm some stuff for the sequel, and I noticed the credits were not functioning properly! I fixed that and also fixed another continuity error I stumbled across with Noah Yarrow. Special shout out to my friend Fiona for being there for me while I was fixing the credits, that was frustrating to deal with for some reason :,) but I got it! Thanks for all your continued support everyone! <33

notes.title: Update #4: Bug Fixes 7/11/24
notes.content:
[i][b]Fourth update of Stellar Version 1.0 has just hit Steam![/b][/i]
Long time no see guys! Some of my friends found some continuity errors within the game, so I fixed those! Plus, I've decided after some thinking that Scarlet fits the aroace label better than just the aromantic label :) thank you so much guys! Working on the sequel right now <3

notes.title: Update #3: Achievement Fixes & Bug Fixes 6/21/23
notes.content:
[i][b]Third update of Stellar Version 1.0 has just hit Steam![/b][/i]
Achievement fixes again, plus I found another bug with James' battle while working on the achievements! Sorry for all the updates, I hope this will be the last one for a while :) Testing will still continue though, and any more issues will be fixed ASAP if there is any! 
Thanks everyone <3
